description: Emergency stop for the whole account: cancel every resting order, close every position on every exchange with reduce-only orders, and block new positions. Use only when the person asks to stop everything or something is clearly wrong. Only a person can resume, on the Web with a verification code; third-party apps never get this permission. Not for closing one position (use close_perp_position_reduce_only). Input: reason. Next: get_my_open_positions to confirm nothing is left.
